title: ARCHIPELAGO — mission-control state.json extension (v1 -> v1+arch)
$comment: STRICTLY ADDITIVE to mission-control's ops/mission/state.json v1 (references/state-schema.md). Everything mission-control and render_sotu.mjs already read is untouched; ARCHIPELAGO adds ONE optional top-level block: 'archipelago'. A v1 file with no block is a valid mission that simply isn't loop-managed. This schema validates only the extension block.

ideaLock.description: Path to idea.lock.json (S0 output). Kickoff copies its definitionOfDone into mission metrics/gates.

ideaLockSHA256.description: Kickoff-captured digest; every loop action rejects lock drift.

planLock.description: Path to plan.lock.json (S1 output). Kickoff copies phases[] into state.phases — a copy, not a translation.

planLockSHA256.description: Kickoff-captured digest; gate ids, titles, and commands must continue to match this plan.

cycle.description: Nth full pass through S0->S7 for this goal.

items.$comment: Routing rule: a failed gate returns to the earliest stage whose output the failure falsifies.

governance.$comment: S6. Honesty rule inherited from NBCLI: enforced vs advisory is stated, never implied.

ledgerRunId.description: NBCLI tamper-evident run ledger id. A merged change with no ledger entry is a governance incident.

branchSweeps.description: Paths to clawsweeper decision files applied this cycle (HITL rule intact).

compound.$comment: S7. Two engines: ce-compound notes into governed memory; autoresearch-style budgeted experiments ON THE PROTOCOL, kept/discarded strictly by measured improvement.

notes.description: Paths to compound notes written this cycle.

change.description: What protocol rule/prompt/gate config was modified.

refusals.$comment: The rewriter's refuse-if-unsafe rule: refusals are logged, never silently dropped.
